 Shaq’s TikTok workout video has fans going crazy: ‘Call me’ 
 By 
 Jenna Lemoncelli 
 Published 
 Oct. 14, 2026, 11:49 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make New York Post a Preferred Source 
 Shaq channeled Arnold Schwarzenegger in a recent workout video and the internet had a field day.
 The “Inside the NBA” host shared a video of him shirtless in the gym while doing reps of arms on a weight machine.
 “Here I come Arnold Shaqanager,” he wrote, including the song “Back Then” by rapper Mike Jones.
 @shaq Here I come Arnold shaqanager
 ♬ Back Then – Mike Jones 
 At one point, he looked directly in the camera and made a grinning face. 
 The comments section was another form of entertainment.

 “Shaq call me,” one person said.
 “Unc is alive I mean ALIVE” someone wrote. 
 “I tried to tell yall Shaq is fine,” another added. 
 3 
 Shaq during a workout video in the gym in October 2026. TikTok/Shaq 
 Shaq was recently named an honorary FBI Special Agent after graduating session 299 at the FBI National Academy in Quantico, Virginia on Sept. 17.
 During a graduation ceremony, the former four-time NBA champion center jokingly told the agents to “arrest Charles Barkley” if they saw his “Inside the NBA” co-host.
 Shaq, who also DJs under the stage name Diesel, is in agreement a long-term deal with TNT Sports that will pay him over $15 million per year, Front Office Sports reported early last year. 
 In November 2024, TNT licensed the Emmy Award–winning “Inside the NBA” to ESPN in exchange for a package of Big 12 college football/basketball games.
